sentences.text:
Aggrieved by the order passed in MVC No.216/2013 dated 24.12.2014 both the claimants as well as insurance company are before this Court, the claimants appeal in MFA No.200496/2015 and the insurance company appeal is MFA No.200365/2015.
2.
The claim petition was filed seeking compensation of an amount of Rs.36.90 lakhs for the death of the deceased in a motor accident that occurred on 13.12.2012.
According to the claimant, the deceased was aged about 30 years and was doing agricultural and petty business and earning an amount of Rs.12,000/- per month.

The Court below considered the salary at Rs.7,000/- per month and by deducting 1/4th had granted an amount of Rs.10,71,000/- under the head of loss of dependency, under the head of loss of estate an amount of Rs.40,000/-, loss of love and affection an amount of Rs.30,000/-, transportation of dead body and funeral expenses Rs.15,000/- and loss of consortium Rs.10,000/-.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:627
All together compensation of an amount of Rs.11,66,000/- is awarded.
When comes to liability it is the case of the insurance company that it is an act policy and the insurance company is not liable.

The Tribunal relying on an judgment in the case of The Branch Manager, New India Insurance Company Ltd. Bijapur Vs. Mahadev Pandurang Patil and Another1, has held that the vehicle is insured by the insurance company and it is liable to pay the compensation.

entities.text: Branch Manager, New India Insurance Company Ltd. Bijapur Vs. Mahadev Pandurang Patil and Another1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Aggrieved thereby the insurance company is before this Court and the claimant is before this Court seeking enhancement of the compensation.
It is the case of the claimants that deceased is earning an amount of Rs.12,000/-, the Court below has taken only Rs.7,000/- as income.
It is stated that even on the other grounds also, the compensation that was awarded is not reasonable.
3. This matter has come up before this Court several times and there was no representation on behalf of 2011(1) MCR 645 (Kar) (DB) NC: 2024:KHC-K:627 the claimant.
On the last occasion this Court heard the learned counsel for the insurance company and posted the matter for disposal today.
Today also there is no representation.
Hence this Court is going ahead with the matter.

4. The learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submits that the Court below went wrong in fastening the liability on the insurance company when the policy is an act policy and no permission is paid to cover the risk of the inmates of the car.
The insurance company is not liable to pay the compensation and the owner alone is liable.

Then coming to the appeal of the claimant seeking enhancement of the compensation, they have claimed that the claimant is earning an amount of Rs.12,000/-, the Court below had taken Rs.7,000/- without time being any evidence.
Learned counsel submits that the compensation that was awarded by the Tribunal was on the higher side.
In the ground of appeal on behalf of claimants.

It is stated that Court failed to grant future prospects and even on the other conventional heads also the amount that was granted by the Tribunal is on the lower side.

sentences.text: Having heard the learned counsel for insurance company and perused the material on record.
In this case, according to the claimant, deceased is earning an amount of Rs.12,000/- no evidence is adduced in this regard.

The Court below had taken Rs.7,000/- as income and this Court is of the view that Court below has reasonable taken, deceased is 30 years old, he is entitle for future prospects at 40% which comes to Rs.2,800/-, (Rs.7,000/- + Rs.2,800) = Rs.9,800/-.
As there are six deponents 1/4th has to be deducted towards personal expenses, it comes to Rs.2,450/-.
Then the contribution to the family would be Rs.7,450/- (Rs.7,450/- x 12 x 17) = Rs.15,19,800/-.
Hence under head of loss of dependency, he is entitled for an amount of Rs.15,19,800/-.
Towards consortium, two children, wife, father and mother (5x48) NC: 2024:KHC-K:627
they are entitled for an amount of Rs.2,40,000/-, towards funeral expenses Rs.36,000/-.
Legal expenses Rs.10,000/-.
All together the claimants are entitled for an amount of Rs.18,05,800/-.

7. Accordingly, the appeal of the claimant i.e. MFA No.200496/2015 is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation from Rs.11,56,000/- to Rs.18,05,800/- which is payable by the owner of the vehicle alone.
Appeal filed by the insurance company is allowed, holding that the insurance company is not liable to pay the compensation.
i) The insurance company is at liberty to withdraw the amount in deposit.
ii) The owner of the vehicle is liable to pay an amount of Rs.18.05.800/-.
iii) The enhanced amount shall carry interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of realization.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:627 iv) The owner of the vehicle shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of copy of the judgment.
On such deposit, the claimant is entitled to withdraw the entire amount without furnishing any security.
v) Registry is directed to return the Trial Court Records to the Tribunal, along with certified copy of the order passed by this Court forthwith without any delay.
vi) The amount in deposit shall be released in favour of the Insurance Company forthwith.
